decision_conditions: The development must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date hereof.Reason: To comply with Section 18 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990, as amended.

Any damage caused to the building by the carrying out of the works hereby approved shall be reported immediately to the Local Planning Authority and details of such remedial works as may be deemed necessary shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and the works carried out in accordance with the approved details within 2 months and thereafter so retained. Reason: To ensure that the internal character, appearance and fabric of the Grade II Listed building is safeguarded and to accord with the requirements of Policy 30 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The works hereby approved are only those specifically stated on the approved 'Heritage Statement at 38 Westcroft Road, Carshalton, SM5 2TG' dated 3rd of November 2025 and approved drawings. Reason: To safeguard the special architectural and historic interests of this Grade II Listed Building in accordance with Policies 28 and 30 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

All external facing materials, treatments and finishes shall be similar to those of the original building and maintained and retained thereafter. Where this is not possible the type and treatment of the materials to be used shall be agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the development being carried out. Reason: To ensure that the proposed development would not result in harm to the visual amenities of the area and the heritage asset in accordance with Policies 28 and 30 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development must be carried out in accordance with the provisions of the Fire Statement (Part A) - Reasonable Exception Statement prepared by Mr N Rigg (MLP Design) and submitted with this application.Reason: To ensure that the development incorporates the necessary fire safety measures in accordance with the Mayor's London Plan Policy D12.
